heading: Today
text: Areas of fog early, otherwise decreasing clouds. Chance of a shower in the northern mountains. Highs in the upper 70s to lower 80s, with some mid 80s in southeastern valleys. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 15 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mainly clear, with areas of river valley fog late. Lows from the mid 50s to around 60, some lower 50s in northern cold hollows. Northwest winds becoming light and variable.

heading: Wednesday
text: Areas of valley fog early; otherwise mostly sunny south, and partly cloudy north. Chance of an afternoon shower, mainly in the Adirondacks, and near the international border; thunder possible. Highs in the upper 70s to lower 80s, except low to mid 80s in southeastern valleys. West winds 5 to 10 mph.
